notes: 2026-10-24 test: 5 concepts built from newest trending Atria statics; 4:5 only, one file per ad, medium quality.

concepts.angle: Lo-fi 'I threw them out' photo: worn-out sneakers in a trash can, the new shoe beside it, heel pain lead (trending: hand/shoe-in-the-trash UGC)
concepts.based_on: Atria trend pull 2026-10-24: lo-fi hand-holding-shoe-in-trash static (22.7% impression pctile, 2 days running); survey PF 25%
concepts.headline: Heel pain? Old sneakers: trash.
concepts.prompt: A raw, phone-snapped real photo in a hospital staff break room: a worn, flattened pair of grey sneakers sitting in an open grey trash can in the lower left, and on the floor right next to it the black-purple pair of shoes from the reference photo, large, sharp and true to proportion, about 45% of the frame. A woman's hand in teal scrub cuffs points at the trash can. Top: huge heavy white headline on a dark solid black bar: "HEEL PAIN?" / "OLD SNEAKERS: TRASH." Natural lighting, slightly imperfect framing like a real UGC photo. All supporting text is large bold, high contrast, max 5 words per label, nothing small or thin. No pills, labels, badges or any other text anywhere except the two-line headline.

concepts.angle: 'Would you rather?' A/B poll: another pair of supportive sneakers vs this shoe, with the full offer stack, teacher knees and back (trending: Would You Rather poll)
concepts.based_on: Atria trend pull 2026-10-24: 'Would You Rather? A or B' poll static (43.2% pctile, new today); offer winners (3.86 ROAS); survey teachers PF 29%
concepts.headline: Would you rather ache or walk?
concepts.prompt: Light sky-blue gradient background. Big heavy dark navy headline at the top: "WOULD YOU RATHER..." Two equal halves split by a thin vertical line. Left half: a plain grey generic sneaker photo (not our shoe, no logo) with large bold text "KEEP KNEES ACHING" and a big solid navy circle with a white letter "A". Right half: the navy shoe from the reference photo, large, sharp, true proportions, about 40% of the frame, with large bold text "STAND ALL DAY, NO ACHE" and a big solid royal blue circle with white letter "B". Bottom: a solid royal blue block across the width with three stacked large bold white lines: "40% OFF", "30-DAY MONEY-BACK GUARANTEE", "FREE SHIPPING". All supporting text is large bold, high contrast, max 5 words per label, nothing small or thin.

concepts.angle: Spanish: three stacked bands 'Hora 1 / Hora 6 / Hora 12' showing the shoe still holding at the end of the shift, flat illustration (trending: Hour One / Hour Six / Hour Twelve stack)
concepts.based_on: Atria trend pull 2026-10-24: 'Hour One / Hour Six / Hour Twelve' 3-band static, 'Stand all day without foot pain' (new, 2 days); survey housekeeping PF 35%
concepts.headline: Hora 12. Todavía de pie.
concepts.prompt: Una ilustración vectorial plana limpia con tres bandas horizontales apiladas del mismo tamaño en colores sólidos (gris, azul marino, negro). Titular enorme y pesado en blanco arriba: "HORA 12." / "TODAVÍA DE PIE." Cada banda muestra una mujer de limpieza en uniforme de pie con el zapato negro del referente, grande y reconocible a proporciones reales, y una etiqueta grande: banda 1 "HORA 1" con "Se siente bien", banda 2 "HORA 6" con "Sigue firme", banda 3 "HORA 12" con "Sin dolor de talón". Todo el texto de apoyo es grande y en negrita, de alto contraste, máximo 5 palabras por etiqueta, nada pequeño ni delgado.

concepts.headline: Foot pain isn't part of the job.
concepts.prompt: A moody dark real photo of a caregiver's legs in dark scrubs on a locker-room bench, the red-burgundy shoe from the reference photo sharp in the foreground, about 40% of the frame, true proportions, lit with a soft rim light. Huge heavy white quote at the top with a clean strikethrough line through it: "FOOT PAIN IS JUST PART OF THE JOB." Under it in bold yellow-white: "IT DOESN'T HAVE TO BE." At the bottom a solid red block with three stacked large bold white lines: "40% OFF", "30-DAY MONEY-BACK GUARANTEE", "FREE SHIPPING". All supporting text is large bold, high contrast, max 5 words per label, nothing small or thin.

concepts.headline: My feet swelled. I kept walking.
concepts.prompt: A solid brand purple background with a few subtle white confetti dots. Large heavy white story-style text in a rounded sans font filling the upper two-thirds, left aligned: "I'M PLUS-SIZE, MY FEET SWELL ON TRIPS. I WALKED 14,000 STEPS IN LISBON AND I FINALLY FELT FINE." Bottom third: the purple shoe from the reference photo on a white rounded tile, large, sharp, true proportions, about 40% of the frame. All supporting text is large bold, high contrast, max 5 words per label, nothing small or thin.
